about: The cases the dash rewrite is held to: a text and whether it is wrapped, a wrapped text reading a paragraph or a list item as one piece across its line breaks, and how many dashes a reading replaces.

withoutDashes.name: a name and its explanation are joined by a colon
args: Drone survey method — high resolution grid
withoutDashes.answer: Drone survey method: high resolution grid

withoutDashes.name: a bold label in a list item takes the colon
a heading's dash takes the colon
args: ## Why these rules — a real case
withoutDashes.answer: ## Why these rules: a real case

withoutDashes.name: an aside between two dashes is set off by commas
args: I think — to be honest — that is right.
withoutDashes.answer: I think, to be honest, that is right.

withoutDashes.name: an aside with commas of its own is set off by brackets
args: Anything larger — a feature, a refactor, a rulebook — is filed as an item.
withoutDashes.answer: Anything larger (a feature, a refactor, a rulebook) is filed as an item.

withoutDashes.name: an aside closed before a comma
args: It keeps the words — all of them —, then stops.
withoutDashes.answer: It keeps the words, all of them, then stops.

withoutDashes.name: past an aside a dash is a colon, and a new sentence starts over
args: Lockdown mode — blocked when on — root is stopped too — no exceptions. Next item — TPM
withoutDashes.answer: Lockdown mode, blocked when on, root is stopped too: no exceptions. Next item: TPM

withoutDashes.name: a footnote mark ends a sentence
args: MoniKa — recovered from memory, MIT.[5] Kakaotalk_decDB — an old-style example.
withoutDashes.answer: MoniKa: recovered from memory, MIT.[5] Kakaotalk_decDB: an old-style example.

withoutDashes.name: a line's opening label is no colon of the sentence
a sentence that has a colon takes a comma
args: Note: the conclusion is this: one — two
withoutDashes.answer: Note: the conclusion is this: one, two

withoutDashes.name: a time's colon is no colon of the sentence
args: Now(20:57) the places passed are 3 — Sunrise
withoutDashes.answer: Now(20:57) the places passed are 3: Sunrise

withoutDashes.name: dashes each inside their own brackets are no pair
an unspaced dash between digits is a range
a dash after a pause mark goes
a dash after an opening bracket goes
a spaced en dash is a dash and an unspaced one a range that stays
a table row keeps its dash
a dash opening a line stays
a dash ending a line stays
a dash after a list mark stays
a dash inside brackets or quotes as a symbol stays
a quoted line stays
a code span stays
quotations stay
args: quoted "OAuth token refresh failed — run /login" as it is, “Lovable — Powering” too
withoutDashes.answer: quoted "OAuth token refresh failed — run /login" as it is, “Lovable — Powering” too

withoutDashes.name: an address stays
a fenced block stays
an unwrapped text reads each line alone
args:
line one —
the next line — end
withoutDashes.answer:
line one —
the next line: end

withoutDashes.name: a text with no dash comes back as it was
args: A text with no dash. As it was.
withoutDashes.answer: A text with no dash. As it was.

withoutDashes.name: several sentences of dashes
args: A — B — C. D — E — F — G
withoutDashes.answer: A, B, C. D, E, F: G

withoutDashes.name: a second pass changes nothing
args: A, B, C. D, E, F: G
withoutDashes.answer: A, B, C. D, E, F: G

withoutDashes.name: Hangul around a dash
an emoji before a dash
a dash between JavaScript-only spaces
a carriage-return line end
an empty text
a wrapped list item is read as one piece and keeps its line breaks
args:
- Anything larger inside a repository —
  a feature, a refactor — is filed as an item. Other work — the
  host's own — is done by hand.
- A new item — its own piece.
withoutDashes.answer:
- Anything larger inside a repository
  (a feature, a refactor) is filed as an item. Other work, the
  host's own, is done by hand.
- A new item: its own piece.

withoutDashes.name: a wrapped aside across a line break
args:
Every other piece
— this one included — stays.
withoutDashes.answer:
Every other piece,
this one included, stays.

withoutDashes.name: a wrapped bold label and an aside with commas
args: - **Long term — years.** What decides returns — fees, tax — is long.
withoutDashes.answer: - **Long term: years.** What decides returns (fees, tax) is long.

withoutDashes.name: wrapped paragraphs are pieces of their own
args:
First paragraph — one.

Second — two — three.
withoutDashes.answer:
First paragraph: one.

Second, two, three.

readDashes.name: one dash between a name and its explanation
args: Drone survey method — high resolution grid

answer.text: Drone survey method: high resolution grid

readDashes.name: an aside counts both its dashes

answer.text: I think, to be honest, that is right.

readDashes.name: a range counts as a dash replaced
an unspaced en dash is no dash
every dash of every sentence counts
args: A — B — C. D — E — F — G

answer.text: A, B, C. D, E, F: G

readDashes.name: a dash inside a fenced block is not counted
a dash inside a code span is not counted
a text with no dash finds none

answer.text: A text with no dash. As it was.

readDashes.name: a wrapped aside across a line break counts both
args:
Every other piece
